purpose: Incremental malicious-behavior and changed-dependency review only; no bug, vulnerability, correctness, test quality or performance assessment.

scope.build: Unchanged central golang:1.26-alpine; go mod download; CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux go build ./cmd/server; CI binary --help
scope.runtime: Unchanged alpine:3.22.0; tzdata and ca-certificates; /app/CLIProxyAPIPlus and config.example.yaml; port 8317; configured provider/Home/plugin/management behavior
scope.method: Every changed file full unified diff read, including all added files and all tests. Identical portions reuse approved baseline; necessary sensitive context separately read. No upstream clone/install/build/test/scan/execution during review.

basis.assessment: Existing configured Redis/Home connections receive cancellation/close wrappers; no new endpoint, command execution or credential export.
Filename sanitization and filename component checks before existing log creation; no new data sink.

Configured plugin/model thinking and user payload rules, token-count transforms, structured errors and Retry-After; redirect policy strips credential headers on cross-origin chains. No new plugin loading, download or remote execution path.
Registry selection and JSON/model metadata transformations. Tool-call names/arguments remain data; not executed by this increment.

Clones request bytes; maps K3.1 family; replays thought signatures and completion state. Caller key is read from trusted gin context then hashed by session.CallerScope and again for existing cache namespace. No raw key transmission added.

Additional missing pack index/file errors enter unchanged configured-remote recovery. Read recovery function and cleanup/rename context; targets remain repository/recovery directories with backup and rollback; no new destructive target or remote.

All changed test/doc hunks read, new test files read in full. Test requests target httptest local servers; filesystem fixtures and registry mocks remain test code. README only removes two community links. No upstream tests executed or assertion-quality audit performed.

limits: 通过 means no malicious behavior evidence found in the stated static increment, not vulnerability/correctness/quality certification.
Unchanged baseline source and dependency toolchains are reused, not freshly reviewed. Upstream development workflows and unexecuted tooling are not recursively recertified.

Central CI may build only after this approval and is not source-review evidence. Existing workflow sets provenance:false; publication checks CI checkout/build chain and OCI revision/source labels, not cryptographic build attestations.
No deployment or service restart is authorized or performed.
All changed files are covered by complete old/new unified diffs; unchanged lines reuse the approved baseline and are explicitly listed, rather than claiming a fresh full repository/source reread.
No changed binary, LFS pointer, submodule, dependency manifest/source, installation script or central build/runtime boundary. No material in-scope unresolved evidence gap.
